content:

title: Longi, Soochow University unveil 34.0% perovskite-silicon tandem solar cell based on dual-anchored interfacial design
content:
Soochow University and Longi researchers developed a ZrO₂ interfacial strategy that reduces recombination and leakage while improving charge extraction in perovskite-silicon tandem solar cells. The resulting device achieved 2.014 V open-circuit voltage and retained 84% of its initial efficiency after 2,000 hours.

content:

title: AI predicts wind-uplift resistance of solar PV piles
content: Researchers in Iran have developed an interpretable artificial neural network to predict the uplift capacity of driven steel piles used in utility-scale PV projects. The model achieved a mean absolute percentage error of 7.63%, with pile penetration rate and soil friction angle emerging as the most influential predictors.

title: New electrode design by German institutes increases battery energy density by up to 15%
content: Fraunhofer ISE and its partners have developed thicker electrodes that could increase battery cell energy density by 10% to 15% without adding weight. The PFAS-free, solvent-free concept has been demonstrated in lithium-ion, sodium-ion, and zinc-ion cells and is designed for cost-effective mass production.

title: US solar can now power 50M homes – and red states led the boom
content: The US achieved a pretty big solar milestone in Q2 2026: it now has enough installed capacity to generate clean electricity equivalent to that used by more than 50 million homes. That’s more than one-third of all US households.

title: Seeing yield loss before it happens: Inline photoluminescence inspection from ingot to tandem
content:
As TOPCon cell efficiencies push past 25% and process windows narrow, the cheapest defect to fix is the one
caught earliest. TTVISION Technologies explains how end-to-end photoluminescence (PL) inspection turns
invisible electrical defects into actionable production data — protecting yield, efficiency and cost at every
stage from crystal ingot to finished cell, and preparing manufacturers for the coming perovskite–silicon
tandem era.
